_meta.pointsCapNote: not in the export: KnowledgeModel has no point-cost field (every node costs 1 point) and no file holds a player-level/points cap. Buying everything takes exactly 134 points.

pointsCapExternal.note: NOT from the export: "reaching level 155 and getting all achievements with Knowledge Point rewards" (Fandom, least trusted; matches data/monkey-knowledge.json maxPoints)

notes: pts = investmentRequired: points already spent in THIS tree before the node can be bought (sets its band/row).

attack rate pct: WeaponReloadPercentageModModel.multiplier; the description says "attack speed +x%" / "reload time -x%". The export has no code, so whether reload is *(1-x) or /(1+x) is not provable here.

applies[].when: crosspaths (or hero levels) whose tower file carries the ApplyModModel. "x-x-3+" = bottom path tier 3 or more. targets = weapon/projectile/ability names the mod is pointed at ("" = whole tower).

canPop props: bloonProperties bitflag Lead 1, Black 2, White 4, Purple 8, Frozen 16 (descriptions of Hot Magic/Hard Tacks = Frozen 16, Strike Down the False = Purple 8, Vine Rupture immune 17 = "non-Lead").
